title: Fresh Water

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Sailors can't drink sea water: it's far too salty! We must fill the casks with fresh water from the spring.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Each cask has a line. Fill each one just to its line, and don't waste a drop.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Fill each cask to its line. Hold the bucket over a cask, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each cask to its line: a quarter, half, three quarters, and full.

feedback.too_full: Over the line! Tap that cask to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Every cask filled, and not a drop wasted. Good work!

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Fresh water for the whole crew. On the sea, water is more precious than gold.

journal_line: I filled the water casks for the voyage home.
